newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Coeur d'Alene rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Coeur d'Alene rating cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said it lowered its six-month near-term rating on Coeur d'Alene Mines Corp to market performer from outperform based on recent price strength.

--On Monday, EVEREN said it cut the company's earnings per share estimates to a loss of $0.38 from a profit of $0.35 for 1997, to a loss of $0.27 from a profit of $0.38 for 1998 and to a loss of $0.11 from a profit of $0.40 for 1999 to reflect EVEREN's current gold price assumptions.
--"At this point we feel comfortable taking profits and lowering our six-month price objective to $19," EVEREN said.
